review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Summary IT System Administrator (with Cloud Expertise and Bilingual Dutch/English) We are looking for a talented and adaptable IT System Administrator with a strong background in both traditional and cloud-based IT infrastructures, particularly Microsoft Azure and M365. Your expertise will ensure the seamless integration of both on-premises and cloud systems. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to bring your cross-platform expertise into play by integrating cloud services with our existing infrastructure, including Citrix Cloud, endpoint management tools, and virtual desktop environments. A minimum of 5 years’ experience in IT system administration, with a solid focus on cloud infrastructure management. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, along with a dynamic work environment where your expertise will be valued.
